title: Lusha Review (2026)
intro: Lusha is a B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact data, enrichment, buying signals, and Engage email sequences. This review evaluates it with SoftwareGlimpse CRM methodology criteria — where pipeline depth is intentionally scored lower than data/outreach strengths.
summary: Lusha fits teams that need accurate B2B contacts and CRM enrichment more than a deal board. Free exists; paid Starter–Scale prices were not verified from the live pricing page in this pass. Scores reflect first-party docs research, not hands-on lab testing.
verdict: Lusha is a strong B2B contact-data and enrichment layer with Engage sequences and CRM sync — not a pipeline CRM. Score it as sales intelligence plugged into your CRM of record. This review is based on first-party Lusha documentation — not hands-on product testing. Public dollar pricing was not verified from lusha.com/pricing during research.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Workspace, Chrome/Edge extension, and Engage are documented as accessible prospecting surfaces; learning curve centers on credits/filters rather than CRM admin.
Lusha is sales intelligence/enrichment, not a visual deal pipeline CRM. Pipeline remains in the buyer’s CRM of record.
Engage sequences, connectors/API automation, and signal-triggered workflows are documented; depth depends on plan and CRM wiring.
Engage supports Gmail/Outlook sequences with AI writing help; not a full marketing ESP.
Analytics/usage dashboards and credit reporting are documented; classic CRM forecast reporting is not the product focus.
Filters, ICP/target profiles, workspace tables, and CRM field mapping provide moderate fit customization.
Native Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Bullhorn plus Zapier/Clay-style connectors and API.
Credit allocation, roles, and enrichment hygiene need ongoing ops attention, but lighter than enterprise CRM suites.
Scale plan, API, and bulk enrichment support growth; credit economics become the practical ceiling.
Free tier exists, but paid USD list prices could not be verified from the live pricing page during research — value judgment stays cautious.

faq.question: How much does Lusha cost?
faq.answer: Lusha documents Free, Starter, Pro, Premium, and Scale plans on a credit system. Exact public USD list prices were not verified from lusha.com/pricing during this research pass (page blocked), so confirm current pricing on Lusha’s site or with sales.

faq.question: Is Lusha a CRM?
faq.answer: No. Lusha is sales intelligence/enrichment with Engage sequences. It syncs into CRMs like Salesforce, HubSpot, and Pipedrive rather than replacing pipeline CRM workflows.

faq.question: Does Lusha include AI features?
faq.answer: Yes. Docs cover an AI Assistant, AI-assisted Workspace tables, Engage AI email help, Conversations meeting analysis, and AI recommendations/scoring.

faq.question: Is this a hands-on SoftwareGlimpse lab review?
faq.answer: No. This review is approved based on first-party Lusha documentation research. SoftwareGlimpse has not recorded hands-on product testing for Lusha in this assessment.

sections.heading: What Lusha is
sections.body: Lusha is a B2B data intelligence platform: find verified contacts, enrich CRM/CSV records, monitor signals, and run Engage sequences. It is designed to feed revenue systems — not to be the deal pipeline itself.

sections.heading: Pricing and plans
sections.body: Docs list Free, Starter, Pro, Premium, and Scale with credits for reveals and related actions. Scale is custom. Because the public pricing page could not be verified live, paid tiers are treated as contact-sales until re-checked.

sections.heading: Core capabilities
sections.body: Documented strengths include Prospect Search/Workspace, extension prospecting, enrichment, Engage sequences, Conversations, signals/AI recommendations, and CRM/API integrations.

sections.heading: Who it’s for
sections.body: Best for sales and RevOps teams improving contact quality and outbound targeting beside an existing CRM. Weak fit if you need the CRM pipeline itself.

productExperience.summary: Teams typically search or extend into LinkedIn, reveal verified contacts, enrich/sync to CRM, optionally enroll Engage sequences, and prioritize with signals/AI recommendations.

workflowSteps.title: Search prospects

workflowSteps.title: Reveal contact data
workflowSteps.description: Spend credits to unlock verified emails and phone numbers via platform or extension.

workflowSteps.title: Enrich CRM/CSV
workflowSteps.description: Push records into Salesforce/HubSpot/Pipedrive or enrich uploads on the Enrich page.

workflowSteps.title: Run Engage sequences

workflowSteps.description: Use job-change/hiring/intent style signals and AI recommendations to prioritize outreach.
